# Pull fixtures

Frozen `ContextCandidateSet v1` inputs for `membrane cli pull plan-context` &
fixture-gateway inputs for `membrane cli pull federate` belong here. Keep payloads
content-free, hash-bound, deterministic, & conformant to
`schemas/context-candidate-set.v1.schema.json`; pair them with expected selection,
headroom, omission, degradation, & publication receipts.
